publication.title: PIBAS FedSPARQL: a web-based platform for integration and exploration of bioinformatics datasets

adjudication.basis: PIBAS FedSPARQL couples template-based federated RDF querying with interactive data-source/property inspection, incremental query expansion and result refinement, providing a concrete human exploration workflow beyond ETL or isolated QA.

tasks: 29 drugs/50 cases; scientists select/judge cases, not controlled interface comparison

limitations: Staff response count not explicitly restated; six custom Likert items called SUS, no standard SUS total

descriptions.interaction: Select topic/subtopic/template/keyword, query federated sources, inspect source-specific properties in accordion lists with descriptions, add properties/re-run, paginate/search/sort results and optionally detect similar data items. Adding a new endpoint requires a SPARQL pattern and expert ontology knowledge.
descriptions.guidance: Predefined templates matched to laboratory tasks, virtual query sentence, source names/statistics, property-description hyperlinks and similar-item suggestions. Similarity relies on expert-selected predicates.
descriptions.visualisation: Paginated tables with URI/string/source fields, source accordion and similarity-result table; not a node-link exploration canvas.
descriptions.backend: RDF/SPARQL federation via local JOSEKI, PHP/Python sparqllib query engine and HTML/jQuery/JavaScript interface; DataSources ontology configures datasets/templates.
